# ♿ Accessibility Audit Template

## Audit metadata

- Feature / release:
- Commit:
- Auditor:
- Date:
- Browser / version:
- Assistive technology / version:
- Viewport and zoom:

## Scope and criteria

Define the pages, interaction states, and WCAG 2.2 criteria assessed. State all exclusions.

## Audit matrix

| Criterion / topic | Expected behavior | Actual evidence | Result | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyboard access | | | | |
| Focus visibility | | | | |
| Accessible names | | | | |
| Status announcements | | | | |
| Reflow and zoom | | | | |
| Contrast | | | | |
| Reduced motion | | | | |
| Error / validation | | | | |

## Findings

For each finding, include steps, impact, affected users, criterion reference, severity, evidence, owner, and remediation.

## Limitations

List untested browsers, assistive technologies, pages, and criteria. Do not state WCAG conformance if any applicable scope remains unassessed.

## Approval

Auditor, reviewer, date, residual issues, and retest evidence.
